# TcLaws

<!-- Generated by `prism docs` from `src/TcLaws.pr`. Do not edit by hand. -->

The property laws of the type-and-row core, run by `prism test`.

These laws state the type-and-row core's contract executably: rigid substitution, zonking idempotence, unification order-independence, generalization's ambient-capture refusal, and deterministic row normalization. Generators stay shallow (types of depth three, labels from a fixed pool) because the laws are structural, not adversarial.
